records.text: Therefore wait for Me, says the Lord, for the day of My rising for testimony. My judgment is for assemblies of nations, to receive kings and pour all My furious wrath upon them; for all the earth will be consumed in My jealous fire.

I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will enter into judgment with them over My people and My inheritance Israel, who were scattered among the nations; and they divided up My land

triples.relationship: assembly of nations for divine judgment
triples.rationale: Zephaniah describes God's judgment for assemblies of nations, to receive kings and pour out wrath; Joel explicitly says God gathers all nations into the valley to enter judgment with them. Both place the international assembly before the judging Lord.
